summary.zh: 指针靠近，按钮整体被吸过去一点，同时一截液体从边缘伸出来去够指针，离开时拉出细颈再“啵”地断开缩回。点一下炸成一圈水珠，再一颗颗融回去。
summary.en: As the pointer nears, the button drifts toward it while a blob of liquid reaches out from the edge; leave and it stretches a thin neck, snaps and retracts. Click and it bursts into droplets that merge back one by one.

technique.zh: SVG goo 滤镜：feGaussianBlur 模糊 + feColorMatrix 把 alpha 拉陡（×24 −10），靠近的形状就会粘连。四个弹簧体：本体、伸出的液体、更远的一滴、文字；液体目标点 = 本体中心 + 方向 × min(距离, 椭圆边缘距离 + reach)。文字不进滤镜，所以始终清晰。
technique.en: SVG goo filter: feGaussianBlur + feColorMatrix steepening alpha (×24 −10) so nearby shapes fuse. Four springs: body, reaching blob, a farther droplet and the label; the blob target is centre + dir × min(distance, ellipse edge + reach). The label stays outside the filter so it is always crisp.

adapt.zh: 按钮文字改 #txt；滤镜半径跟着 rem 算，放大缩小都不会糊。注意 goo 层要比按钮大一圈，不然水珠飞出去会被裁掉。
adapt.en: Edit #txt for the label; the blur scales with rem so it holds at any size. Keep the goo layer larger than the button or flying droplets get clipped.
